entities.name: Updated PEIPS assistance information
entities.description: Information element that provides updated PEIPS assistance information to the UE when certain conditions are met.

entities.name: UE supports NR paging subgrouping
entities.description: Condition that the UE must support NR paging subgrouping for the AMF to include the updated PEIPS assistance information IE.

entities.name: AMF supports and accepts PEIPS assistance information
entities.description: Condition that the AMF must support and accept the use of PEIPS assistance information for the UE.

entities.name: UE not registered for emergency services
entities.description: Condition that the UE must not be registered for emergency services.

entities.name: UE has no active emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition that the UE must not have an active emergency PDU session.

entities.name: Network needs to update PEIPS assistance information
entities.description: Condition that the network needs to update PEIPS assistance information for the UE.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that may include the updated PEIPS assistance information IE when conditions are met.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives the updated PEIPS assistance information when conditions are satisfied.

relations.description: AMF may include the updated PEIPS assistance information IE in messages when conditions are met.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE supports NR paging subgrouping.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that AMF supports and accepts PEIPS assistance information.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE is not registered for emergency services.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE has no active emergency PDU session.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that network needs to update PEIPS assistance information.
